description: This file defines a class WebDeviceInterface that provides methods for interacting with localStorage, managing database entries, and keychain values within a web environment. It includes functions for storage retrieval, parsing, saving, removal, and device reset operations.

classes.name: WebDeviceInterface
classes.description: A class providing web storage and device management functionalities.

methods.name: getRawStorageValue
methods.description: Retrieves a raw value from localStorage by key.

methods.name: getJsonParsedRawStorageValue
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a JSON value from localStorage.

methods.name: setRawStorageValue
methods.description: Sets a raw value in localStorage.

methods.name: removeRawStorageValue
methods.description: Removes a specific key from localStorage.

methods.name: removeAllRawStorageValues
methods.description: Clears all entries in localStorage.

methods.name: openDatabase
methods.description: Stub method for opening a database, returns empty object.

methods.name: _getDatabaseKeyPrefix
methods.description: Generates a key prefix for database entries based on an identifier.

methods.name: _keyForPayloadId
methods.description: Generates a storage key for a payload ID and identifier.

methods.name: getAllDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Retrieves all database entries matching a prefix.

methods.name: getDatabaseLoadChunks
methods.description: Loads database entries in chunks, sorted by priority.

methods.name: saveDatabaseEntry
methods.description: Saves a single payload to localStorage.

methods.name: saveDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Saves multiple payloads to localStorage.

methods.name: removeDatabaseEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific database entry by ID.

methods.name: removeAllDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Removes all database entries with a specific prefix.

methods.name: getNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Retrieves a namespaced keychain value.

methods.name: setNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Sets a namespaced keychain value.

methods.name: clearNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Clears a specific keychain value.

methods.name: getRawKeychainValue
methods.description: Retrieves the entire keychain object from localStorage.

methods.name: clearRawKeychainValue
methods.description: Removes the keychain from localStorage.

methods.name: performSoftReset
methods.description: Stub for soft reset operation.

methods.name: performHardReset
methods.description: Stub for hard reset operation.

methods.name: isDeviceDestroyed
methods.description: Returns false indicating device is not destroyed.

methods.description: Stub for cleanup operations.
